sample_message: Your SBI account will be blocked today. Update KYC at http://sbi-kyc.example.test and enter your OTP.
risk_indicators: Urgency; impersonation; suspicious link; OTP request
expected_explanation: Claims immediate account closure and asks for an OTP through an unverified link.

sample_message: Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight due to unpaid bill. Call 9876543210 immediately.
expected_explanation: Uses a disconnection threat and directs the recipient to an unverified number.

sample_message: Earn ₹5,000 daily by liking videos. Pay ₹499 registration fee to activate your work account.
risk_indicators: Upfront fee; unrealistic earnings; vague job
expected_explanation: Promises easy high income and demands an advance fee for a vague task-based job.

sample_message: Invest ₹10,000 today and receive guaranteed ₹50,000 in seven days. Limited slots!
expected_explanation: Promises an implausibly high guaranteed return and pressures the recipient to act quickly.

sample_message: Your parcel is on hold. Pay ₹5 redelivery fee at http://delivery-help.example.test within 30 minutes.
risk_indicators: Small-fee bait; urgency; suspicious link; delivery impersonation
expected_explanation: A tiny payment is used to lure the recipient to an unverified delivery link.

sample_message: Congratulations, you have won a new smartphone. Pay ₹1,999 shipping and processing charges to claim your prize.
expected_explanation: An unexpected prize requiring payment before delivery is a common advance-fee warning sign.

sample_message: I am your bank manager. Send your debit card number, expiry date and CVV so I can reverse the failed transaction.
risk_indicators: Bank impersonation; sensitive financial data request
expected_explanation: A genuine bank should not ask for card security details over chat.

sample_message: Your UPI account is frozen. Share the OTP you just received with our verification team to restore access.
expected_explanation: Requests an OTP and uses account suspension pressure; OTPs must never be shared.

sample_message: We are hiring urgently in Germany. No interview required. Send passport scan and ₹15,000 visa fee to reserve your job.
risk_indicators: Upfront fee; identity document request; no interview
expected_explanation: Requests money and sensitive identity documents for an unusually easy overseas job offer.

sample_message: Your friend has lost their phone. I am using a new number. Please transfer ₹18,000 urgently; I will explain later.
expected_explanation: An urgent payment request from a new number should be verified through a known contact method.

sample_message: Your FASTag will be suspended. Update your vehicle details at http://fastag-verify.example.test now.
expected_explanation: Uses a service warning and an unverified link to collect personal or payment information.

sample_message: Your mailbox storage is full. Sign in at http://mail-quota.example.test within one hour or your account will be deleted.
expected_explanation: The message uses a threat and an unverified sign-in link to capture credentials.

sample_message: Earn commission by receiving money in your bank account and forwarding it to another account. Keep 10%.
risk_indicators: Money mule recruitment; suspicious financial activity
expected_explanation: Recruiting someone to move third-party funds can expose them to fraud and money-laundering risks.

sample_message: You have been selected for a government subsidy. Pay ₹250 verification charges to release ₹25,000.
risk_indicators: Government impersonation; advance fee; unrealistic benefit
expected_explanation: A supposed subsidy is conditioned on an advance payment through an unsolicited message.

sample_message: Your tax refund is approved. Confirm your PAN, bank account and password using this form: http://refund-check.example.test
risk_indicators: Tax authority impersonation; sensitive data request; suspicious link
expected_explanation: Requests sensitive tax and banking information through an unverified form.

sample_message: Join our crypto signal group. We guarantee 20% weekly profit and will refund losses if you follow every trade.
risk_indicators: Guaranteed returns; investment pressure; unverifiable claim
expected_explanation: Guarantees unusually high investment returns and makes claims that cannot be independently verified.

sample_message: आपका बैंक खाता आज बंद हो जाएगा। KYC अपडेट करने के लिए इस लिंक पर क्लिक करें और OTP दर्ज करें: http://kyc-help.example.test
risk_indicators: खाते की धमकी; OTP मांगना; संदिग्ध लिंक
expected_explanation: खाता बंद होने का डर दिखाकर लिंक पर OTP मांगता है। OTP किसी के साथ साझा न करें।

sample_message: మీ బ్యాంక్ ఖాతా బ్లాక్ అవుతుంది. KYC కోసం ఈ లింక్‌లో OTP నమోదు చేయండి: http://kyc-help.example.test
risk_indicators: ఖాతా బ్లాక్ అవుతుందనే బెదిరింపు; OTP అభ్యర్థన; అనుమానాస్పద లింక్
expected_explanation: ఖాతా బ్లాక్ అవుతుందని భయపెట్టి OTP అడుగుతోంది. OTPను ఎవరితోనూ పంచుకోవద్దు.

sample_message: Aapka SIM 2 ghante mein band ho jayega. KYC ke liye link kholo aur Aadhaar OTP bhejo.
risk_indicators: SIM suspension threat; urgency; OTP request
expected_explanation: Uses a SIM-blocking threat and asks for an Aadhaar OTP; verify only through the operator's official app or store.

sample_message: This is police cyber cell. A case is registered against your Aadhaar. Pay ₹7,500 now or you will be arrested.
expected_explanation: Impersonates law enforcement and demands immediate payment to avoid arrest.

sample_message: Your bank account was debited by ₹1,500 through UPI on 25-Nov. If you did not make this transaction, contact your bank using the number on its official website or card.
expected_explanation: Provides a transaction alert and recommends independently finding the bank's official contact details.

sample_message: Your interview for the Embedded C++ Developer role is scheduled for Friday at 11:00 AM. Please reply to confirm your availability.
risk_indicators: Recruitment communication; no payment or sensitive-data request
expected_explanation: A routine interview scheduling email with no suspicious demand.

sample_message: Reminder: Your credit card payment of ₹4,500 is due on 30 November. Pay through your bank's official app.
expected_explanation: A normal payment reminder that directs the recipient to the bank's official app.

sample_message: I have reached the office. The meeting is at 3 PM in conference room B.
expected_explanation: Ordinary logistical message with no suspicious request.

sample_message: Attached is the meeting agenda for tomorrow's project review. Please add your updates before 5 PM.
expected_explanation: A standard work email requesting agenda updates, without unusual links or payment requests.

sample_message: Your OTP for login is 482913. Do not share this OTP with anyone. If you did not request it, secure your account.
expected_explanation: A standard OTP alert that explicitly warns the recipient not to share the code.

sample_message: Your order has shipped. Track it from the Orders section of the shopping app you used to place the order.
expected_explanation: A routine order notification that directs the recipient to the app they already use.

sample_message: Your electricity bill of ₹1,240 has been generated. Please view and pay it in the official electricity board app.
risk_indicators: Utility bill notification; official app guidance
expected_explanation: A normal bill notification that recommends using the official app.

sample_message: कल की मीटिंग सुबह 10 बजे है। कृपया रिपोर्ट साथ लेकर आएँ।
expected_explanation: A normal meeting reminder with no suspicious request.

sample_message: రేపు ఉదయం 10 గంటలకు మీటింగ్ ఉంది. దయచేసి రిపోర్ట్ తీసుకురండి.
expected_explanation: సందేహాస్పద అభ్యర్థనలేని సాధారణ సమావేశ గుర్తుచూపు.

sample_message: Thank you for applying. We have received your application and will share an update after the hiring team reviews it.
expected_explanation: A routine application acknowledgement; it does not request money or sensitive information.

sample_message: Your broadband bill is ready. The amount due is ₹899 by 5 December. View the bill in your provider's official app.
expected_explanation: A routine bill reminder that points to the provider's official app.

sample_message: Can you send me the notes from today's class when you get a chance?
expected_explanation: A normal request between contacts, with no payment or credential demand.

sample_message: The company has updated its leave policy. Please read the policy document on the employee portal using your usual bookmark.
expected_explanation: A routine internal announcement directing employees to a familiar portal.

sample_message: Your appointment is confirmed for 26 November at 4:30 PM. Reply 1 to confirm or call the clinic using the number on your appointment slip.
expected_explanation: A routine appointment reminder with a verification route tied to existing paperwork.

sample_message: Your KYC needs attention. Please check your bank's official mobile app or visit a branch. Do not share OTPs or PINs.
expected_explanation: The wording advises independent verification through official channels and explicitly warns against sharing secrets.

sample_message: Hi, I am Rahul from the delivery team. I could not find your apartment. Can you share the building name?
risk_indicators: Unverified sender; request for location detail
expected_explanation: Could be a genuine delivery query, but the sender is unverified. Confirm through the retailer or delivery app before sharing details.

sample_message: Your KYC is pending. Please call customer support at 1800-000-000 to know the next steps.
expected_explanation: The message does not include a link or ask for an OTP, but the number is unverified. Find the bank's contact number independently.

sample_message: We reviewed your resume and would like to discuss a remote role paying ₹1.5 lakh per month. Reply with your availability and job details will follow.
risk_indicators: Unsolicited high salary; limited role details
expected_explanation: This may be legitimate, but the sender and role are not identified and the pay claim is unusually attractive. Verify the company and vacancy.

sample_message: Your parcel is delayed. Please confirm the last four digits of your phone number so we can locate the shipment.
expected_explanation: Could be a delivery workflow, but verify the sender in the official tracking app before sharing personal details.

sample_message: A payment request for ₹8,999 is pending on your UPI app. Approve it if you made the purchase.
risk_indicators: Payment approval prompt; possible UPI collect request
expected_explanation: A UPI collect request can debit money when approved. Check the payee and amount in the app; decline if unexpected.

sample_message: Please review the attached invoice and process payment by Friday. Regards, Accounts Team.
expected_explanation: Could be routine business email, but the sender, invoice and bank details should be verified through a known contact before payment.

sample_message: Sir, aapka resume shortlist hua hai. Salary 80k tak hai. Pehle company details aur interview schedule bhej sakte hain?
risk_indicators: Recruitment discussion; asks for verifiable details
expected_explanation: The message asks for company and interview details rather than money or sensitive information. Verify the recruiter independently.

sample_message: Your parcel is out for delivery. Please keep the exact cash amount ready if you selected cash on delivery.
expected_explanation: A routine delivery update, provided the recipient is expecting a cash-on-delivery order.

sample_message: I changed my number. Please save this contact. We can talk when you are free.
expected_explanation: Could be a genuine contact, but confirm the person's identity using their old number or another known channel before trusting future requests.

sample_message: We are conducting a free online interview preparation webinar. Register through the events page on our official company website.
expected_explanation: This may be legitimate, but confirm the sender and navigate to the company's official website independently rather than trusting an unexpected link.

sample_message: Your bank has detected unusual activity. Open the bank app directly or call the number printed on your card if you do not recognise a transaction.
expected_explanation: A safety-oriented alert that tells the recipient to use the app directly or a trusted number.

sample_message: नमस्ते, मैं डिलीवरी एजेंट हूँ। आपका पता अधूरा दिख रहा है। कृपया ऐप में ऑर्डर विवरण जांच लें।
expected_explanation: The message directs the recipient to check order details in the app rather than clicking an unsolicited link.

sample_message: మీ ఉద్యోగ దరఖాస్తు అందింది. తదుపరి దశల వివరాలను కంపెనీ అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో చూడండి.
expected_explanation: A routine application update that points to the company's official website.

sample_message: Final warning: Your account may be restricted unless you verify your identity. The email address is unfamiliar and the button says 'Verify Now'.
risk_indicators: Urgency; account threat; unknown sender; button link
expected_explanation: The pressure and unfamiliar sender are warning signs, but the actual sender and destination URL should be inspected before making a definitive scam judgment.
